post.title: Skylight Installation Redmond WA — Permits, Energy Code U-Factors, Roof Framing and Leak-Proof Flashing
post.description: A Redmond homeowner's guide to adding or replacing a skylight: when the City requires a building permit, how to apply, Washington's skylight U-factor limits, roof framing, flashing that stays dry, electrical permits for powered units, and how to verify the crew.
